motion.name: reduced-motion

components.css: .ds-attachment{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border,#17171a1a);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#17171a);font:12px/1.6 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei UI',system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:260px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease}.ds-attachment svg{flex:none;color:var(--muted,#55555e)}.ds-attachment span{overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-attachment:hover,.ds-attachment:active{background:var(--hover,#17171a14)}.ds-attachment:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0b6e3b);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-attachment{transition:none}}

components.name: Learning card
components.description: Shared Android learning shell with base-background surface, business accent and formula-aware type heading.
components.html:
学习讲解

结合图像、公式与操作理解概念。
components.css: .ds-card{--surface:var(--background,#f7f7f9);--primary:var(--accent,#0e8a4a);min-width:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#17171a);border:1px solid var(--border,#17171a1a);border-radius:20px;font:16px/1.5 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei UI',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-card-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 12px 4px 18px}.ds-card-head>svg{color:var(--primary,#0b6e3b)}.ds-card-head h2{margin:0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:normal}.ds-card-description{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted,#55555e);margin:0;padding:0 18px 12px}.ds-card-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border,#17171a1a);padding:4px 12px}.ds-card-footer button{font:14px/1.6 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei UI',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#55555e);min-height:48px;padding:10px 8px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease}.ds-card-footer button:hover,.ds-card-footer button:active{background:var(--hover,#17171a14)}.ds-card-footer button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0b6e3b);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card-footer button{transition:none}}

components.name: Bottom composer
components.description: Android-shaped 28px composer with a small plus control, model selector and circular business-accent send action.
components.html: 选择模型
components.css: .ds-composer{max-width:800px;border:1px solid var(--border,#17171a1a);background:var(--composer,#fff);border-radius:28px;padding:8px 8px 6px;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #00000008;font:16px/1.6 "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei UI", system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--muted,#55555e)}.ds-composer textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:56px;max-height:180px;resize:none;outline:none;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--foreground,#17171a);font:16px/24px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei UI", system-ui, sans-serif;padding:4px 6px 8px;caret-color:var(--primary,#0b6e3b)}.ds-composer textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#55555e)}.ds-composer-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;gap:8px;color:var(--muted,#55555e);font-size:13px}.ds-composer-toolbar button{display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer}.ds-composer-toolbar .ds-add{width:28px;height:28px;background:var(--selector,#eeeef2);color:var(--foreground,#17171a)}.ds-composer-toolbar .ds-send{width:36px;height:36px;margin-left:auto;background:var(--accent,#0e8a4a);color:#fff}.ds-send:hover{filter:brightness(.92)}.ds-composer-toolbar button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0b6e3b);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
This app extends the existing Android learning interface. Neutral grey and chalk surfaces, ink text, the emerald W, and restrained rounded controls remain the visual identity. Windows system typography serves Chinese and English study material, while bundled textbook mathematics and highlighted code retain their own reading conventions. This is an app-scoped record of the implemented Windows extension, not a replacement identity for Android.

Android is the visual authority for this unified surface. `scripts/sync-android-design.mjs` generates `src/android-design.css` from Android `Color.kt`, `src/android-brand.ts` from `brand_mark.xml`, and `app-icon.svg` from the launcher vector and launcher background. `src/main.tsx` loads shared learning styles, desktop layout styles, then the generated Android roles. The frontmatter mirrors these scoped runtime values; update the Android source and generator when changing shared roles rather than treating a documentation snapshot as an independent theme. `SURFACE.md` records the Windows composition; `../../PRODUCT.md` remains the product context.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral surfaces with emerald identity and content accents.
Android-derived colors, marks, bubbles and composer with Windows study typography.
Readable Chinese and English text, textbook mathematics, and code.
Shared learning components retain their Android visual vocabulary.

rules.name: The Android Role Rule
rules.body: Preserve the distinct Android roles for neutral primary buttons, readable links, business accents and the W mark. Learning content has its own scoped role overrides; do not flatten those scopes into one global primary color.

rules.name: The Study Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve the separate typography of prose, equations and code instead of flattening all three into app labels.

dos: Do preserve the Android neutral/chalk world and emerald W when extending Windows.
Do synchronize shared colors and marks from their Android sources.
Do preserve separate reading treatments for prose, mathematics and code.
Do make keyboard focus and icon-button names visible or accessible as implemented.
Do keep overlay depth functional and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do retain the editable SVG and raster provenance when shipping icons.
donts: Don't replace the incumbent identity with a new desktop brand or display-font theme.
Don't promote chart, explanation or syntax colors into general app chrome.
Don't collapse chrome and learning-content color scopes into a single action palette.
Don't turn this surface's sidebar/composer composition into a rule for unrelated future screens.
Don't populate the intentionally empty Tools entry with invented student features.
Don't use earlier pre-unification screenshots as authority for current tokens.
